title: Q-YEAR-model-refresh-host: refresh the model catalog from the tick Worker
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** UNATTENDED-365 register, dependency `model-refresh-host` is open
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation unattended --probe model-refresh-host
**Status:** open

Port modelwatch refresh to a tick step that runs each named model once a day on the AI binding, writes the result to D1 and opens a handoff PR that rewrites retired ids.
When it holds, set the dependency's status to closed in doctrine/unattended.json with the evidence and a probe that proves it.
